changeSet.comment: Auto-unlock achievements based on existing user statistics
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_achievements (user_id, achievement_type, progress, completed, completed_at, notified, created_at) SELECT user_id, 'FIRST_GENERATION', 100, true, created_at, false, NOW() FROM user_profiles WHERE total_generations >= 1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE completed = true, completed_at = user_profiles.created_at;
